title: #moulinrouge
transcript: broadway coffee talk hmm yesterday i saw a matinee of the first national tour of Moulin Rouge the tour has opened in chicago at the nederland theater this is my first time seeing the show i've seen the movie of course. my first time seeing the stage adaptation and i mean overall i had a great time it was a lot of fun it's a beautiful show to look at the sets are fantastic especially for a national tour our cast was phenomenal here's the cast that we saw but here's our cast i gotta say Yvette Gonzalez-Nacer was fantastic as Satine. now for a few quibbles the way the set design for this tour is structured the playing space is set way back far on the stage and the Nederlander theater Has like a 10 foot wide orchestra pit and we were sitting in the nosebleeds so the show felt really distant and for a show that should feel really much in your face it felt like we're watching a show playing in another room the cast the most part overcame this huge gap but it's still for me it was a problem especially for those ticket prices but overall we had a really good time we did
reasoning: The reviewer had a 'great time' and found the show 'a lot of fun' with a 'phenomenal' cast and 'fantastic' sets, but had notable quibbles about the staging distance and ticket prices that tempered the overall enthusiasm.
